summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K responding to a Brazilian SEC (CVM) inquiry about a newspaper report that its creditors demand all assets as collateral in a capital restructuring. The company confirms it retained advisors since September 2025 and exchanged non-binding proposals with note/debenture holders since June 2026, with terms including a potential capitalization and security interests. A Brazilian court granted a 60-day stay on enforcement actions to facilitate mediation. No definitive agreement or material terms have been reached. Watch for creditor negotiations, court mediation timeline, and risk of judicial reorganization if talks fail.
